schoolName: University of Panama Faculty of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD — The University of Panama Faculty of Medicine runs the Doctor en Medicina programme. Its published 2027 Faculty admission information and university news confirm a competitive admissions process that accommodates foreign places by examination score; the current Faculty page is specifically for 2027. The Faculty's official materials identify the 2018 updated curriculum, and a September 2025 university report says the course is accredited through 2028 and has an endorsement from COMAEM. However, no current 2026/27 full fee schedule for Doctor en Medicina, explicit language-of-instruction statement, foreign-student visa/accommodation/support terms, or audience-relevant graduate licensing pathway was found. The candidate must remain a research hold.
